_comment: Audio Bibles the reader can play, and where they come from. tools/build-audio.mjs reads each source's page and writes data/audio/<id>.json (one entry per recorded chapter) and the 'audio' entry of data/research.json. The files themselves stay on the source's site: the player streams them from there, unchanged.

sources.title: Библия. Синодальный перевод
sources._readersComment: Alexander Bondarenko reads the whole Bible except 15 Old Testament books; for those the page uses Ilya Prudovsky's reading of the Synodal text (Chicago, 1989). Four of them are in the 66-book canon. Source: the note on the page («Бондаренко не начитаны 15 книг Ветхого Завета…»).

credit.name: Предание.ру
credit._termsComment: predanie.ru's user agreement, 2.2.1: its audio may be used free of charge without written consent for non-commercial use, provided each public use gives the source and a hyperlink to the page the material comes from, at the beginning, clearly visible, naming «Предание.ру» (3.1.3: in type no smaller than the text around it). 2.2.2: no changes to the material. Commercial use needs a contract with the Foundation (2.3).

sources._numberingComment: The recording's chapters follow the printed Synodal Bible: Psalms in the Greek numbering (its Psalm 22 is the KJV's Psalm 23), and a few chapter boundaries a verse or two apart. Each recorded chapter is matched to the site's (KJV-numbered) chapters with the Synodal numbering in data/rst.json.
sources._fixesComment: Files whose title on the page gives the wrong chapter (file id → chapter). The build checks that each book's chapters run 1, 2, 3… with none missing, so a new slip stops it.

297369.why: Numbers: titled «Глава 13», but the file is …-glava-15.mp3 and comes between chapters 14 and 16

sources._skipComment: Books outside the 66-book canon the site shows.
